segments.text:
V. 2.
By themſelves—That is, ſeparate from the Multitude: Apart—From the other Apoſtles: And was transfigured—The Greek Word ſeems to refer to the Form of GOD, and the Form of a Servant (mentioned by St. Paul, Phil. ii. 6, 7.) and may intimate, That the Divine Rays, which the indwelling GOD let out on this Occaſion, made the glorious Change from one of theſe Forms into the other.
